plant.configure.function_zh: 显式有限响应/热/观测工程模型

power.set.function_zh: 电源开关，过程只由step推进

clamp.set.function_zh: 抬头且静止时手动锁紧试片

stage.move.function_zh: 抬头后异步XY对位，不能瞬移

head.set_position.function_zh: 粗抬头目标，速度为显式工程参数

tool.select.function_zh: 仅软件工位选择；固定显微镜靠Y台对位，不虚构转塔

contact.set.function_zh: 工位到位后允许接触加载；卸载必须等待真实载荷释放

sensor.calibrate.function_zh: 外部标定参数，不免费读取过程真值

sensor.zero.function_zh: 无接触静止状态独立传感器零点

method.configure.function_zh: 预扫描/单道划痕/后扫描以及显式观察判据

acquisition.start.function_zh: 异步真实加载/进给/卸载，保留有限损伤轨道

acquisition.stop.function_zh: 取消冻结部分测量，保留损伤并按宿主步进卸载

acquisition.result.function_zh: 纯读属于操作owner的冻结结果

reference.query.function_zh: 原曲线/图像/工况参考，不将FnC/Rd空值冒实测

image.reference.function_zh: 仅返回实文献划痕图像索引，非本次动态显微成像

analysis.critical_load.function_zh: 由外部观测的包围阈值交点得到Lc；非固有粘附强度

debris.collect.function_zh: 抬头松夹具回收有限涂层/基底/压头碎屑

ledger.read.function_zh: 有限涂层/基底/压头/碎屑和切向热、法向弹簧账本

sim.step.function_zh: 唯一宿主物理推进入口

emergency.stop.function_zh: 本地软件停机锁存，非原厂急停认证

emergency.reset.function_zh: 载荷卸除后明确复位，不自动续划

plant.configured.meaning_zh: 显式工程参数已接受；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

power.enabled.meaning_zh: 供电；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

clamp.locked.meaning_zh: 试片夹具锁紧；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

contact.engaged.meaning_zh: 压头接触使能；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

specimen.present.meaning_zh: 有限试片存在；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

stylus.present.meaning_zh: 有限压头存在；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

emergency.latched.meaning_zh: 软件安全停机锁存；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

stage.moving.meaning_zh: 抬头后的对位移动中；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

head.moving.meaning_zh: 粗抬头目标未到达；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

stage.x_m.meaning_zh: X向划痕移动台（stage_x）实际X台位置，范围 0–0.07 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

stage.y_m.meaning_zh: Y向移动承板（stage_y）实际Y台位置，范围 -0.03–0.03 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

head.lift_m.meaning_zh: 测量头粗升降承板（load_head）头部粗抬升，0为名义接触平面，范围 0–0.04 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

head.penetration_m.meaning_zh: 微位移压头承杆（stylus）弹簧压入与局部移除槽深的工程姿态，不是校准Pd真值，范围 0–0.001 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

clamp.release_m.meaning_zh: 手动松开前钳口（clamp_jaw）夹具手动释放代理，范围 0–0.003 m；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

power.angle_rad.meaning_zh: 后电源摇臂开关（power_switch）电源开关工程姿态，范围 0–0.28 rad；场景机械状态，关节坐标 0 为闭合/初始位，行程为教学假设而非厂家实测；同步权威与方向见 model_bindings。

stage.target_x_m.meaning_zh: X对位目标，范围 0–0.07 m；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

stage.target_y_m.meaning_zh: Y对位目标，范围 -0.03–0.03 m；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

head.target_lift_m.meaning_zh: 粗抬头目标，范围 0–0.04 m；设定值，由 head.set_position 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

load.target_n.meaning_zh: 当前高量程加载控制目标，非实际法向力，范围 0–200 N；设定值，由 power.set 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

tool.mode.meaning_zh: 软件工位；固定物镜通过台Y对位，非转塔；设定值，由 tool.select 写入，只记录目标，不等于实际值，也不推进过程。

load.indicated_n.meaning_zh: 实际工程力经独立gain/offset/响应的观测；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

friction.indicated_n.meaning_zh: 源Ft/FnC派生代理经实际载荷与独立观测；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

friction.coefficient.meaning_zh: 观测Ft除观测Fn，非直接读取源真实系数；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

depth.raw_m.meaning_zh: 含基线/弹性/局部残余的工程深度观测；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

depth.penetration_m.meaning_zh: 主划痕观测减同坐标预扫描，非卸载后残余；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

depth.residual_m.meaning_zh: 只有后扫描可得的同坐标残余观测；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

thermal.indicated_k.meaning_zh: 理想集中节点温度，未实现校准噪声；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

truth.normal_force_n.meaning_zh: 一阶闭环实际载荷，≥0 N；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.coating_volume_m3.meaning_zh: 有限涂层剩余体积，≥0 m^3；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.substrate_volume_m3.meaning_zh: 有限基底剩余体积，≥0 m^3；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.stylus_volume_m3.meaning_zh: 有限压头剩余体积，≥0 m^3；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.debris_kg.meaning_zh: 涂层基底压头碎屑总质量，≥0 kg；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.local_groove_m.meaning_zh: 当前被移除的局部平均槽深，≥0 m；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

truth.temperature_k.meaning_zh: 样品瓶内液体温度（能量守恒求解），≥0 K；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测；集中热节点真值。

truth.tangential_work_j.meaning_zh: 源响应作用于实际位移的切向耗散，≥0 J；过程真值，仅 evaluator/debug 可见，无传感器噪声与量化，用于守恒与评测，不是厂家实测。

clock.time_s.meaning_zh: 宿主唯一时钟，≥0 s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

acquisition.phase.meaning_zh: 操作生命周期；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

acquisition.pass_phase.meaning_zh: 真实加载/扫描/卸载阶段；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

acquisition.distance_m.meaning_zh: 本次实际划程，范围 0–0.07 m；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

acquisition.elapsed_s.meaning_zh: 实际经过时间，≥0 s；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

acquisition.points.meaning_zh: 实际记录点数，范围 0–250000；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

observation.unavailable_reason.meaning_zh: 未接触/量程/基线不可用原因；由运行层模型推导，面向 agent 的观测值；未经实机标定，不代表厂家传感器精度。

scratch.meaning_zh: 实源切向响应与有限能量分配划痕、独立观察和同道前后扫描
equations: Fn_target(x)=Fstart+(Fend-Fstart)*x/L for progressive or constant load. dFn/dt=(Fn_target-Fn)/tau. Exact linear-target solution and two integral moments; hostfixed0.1s with <=10ms internal and source-knot events. High range Fn,Ft<=200N, depth<=1mm, speed0.4..600mm/min and length<=70mm.

mu_proxy(x)=max(Ft_source(x),0)/FnC_source(x) at source nodes, piecewise linear. FnC is the source command/control channel, not measured normal load. Source original Ft/Pd/Rd/mu arrays are preserved; negative projection requires explicit acceptance and result modification count. x_source=source_start+actual travel; no axis normalization or extrapolation.

W_t=integral Fn_actual(t)*mu_proxy(x(t))*v dt exactly on source-linear segments with analytic exponential force moments. Measured friction channel has independent gain/offset/tau; observed mu=Fobs/Nobs. Source native mu is not asserted to equal the derived nominal-load ratio.

Explicit energy allocation eta_sample+eta_stylus<=1. For each new path increment, coating removal capped by width*thickness*dx then substrate removal, with dV=dW_removal/u. Stylus dV=eta_stylus*dW_t/u_stylus. Each density transfers removed mass to separate debris. Unallocated work enters finite heat node, C*dT/dt=Pheat-G*(T-Tambient).

Ideal normal spring U=Fn^2/(2k). Positive deltaU tracked as loading work, negative deltaU as recovered actuator work; no normal energy disappears on unloading. Full normal plastic/topographic work is not solved and is not relabeled as tangential heat.

Local average groove=(dVcoat+dVsubstrate)/(declared width*dx), stored along the exact finite damaged path. Raw depth=Fn/k+local_groove-surface_slope*stageX, through independent sensor response. Prescan and postscan use explicitly assumed nondestructive low force. Penetration and residual observations subtract the same-path prescan; never treat source zero Rd as measured zero residual.

Critical threshold detection requires adjacent available observations and consecutive confirmation; missing points break a bracket. It reports an observed criterion, not intrinsic adhesion. Postscan residual crossings map to preserved original same-track scratch observedFn(position), never the low probing force; without load bracket Lc=null.

Damaged overlapping tracks cannot be reused; arbitrary multipass does not reset finite coating. Cancellation stops feed and freezes history but actual normal load relaxes on later steps. Fixed optical microscope has no simulated carousel; published image lookup is reference-only, dynamic panorama and AE calibration are unsupported.

原始数据跨型号响应迁移不是RST300原机校准。
未知涂层/基底力学、接触刚度、损伤和回复动力学、热损耗、传感器误差、图像生成必须显式工程输入，不从Lc或μ推造。
用户物质覆盖目标按材料/涂层-基底体系去重；52记录仅14身份，重复、氮化和退火/厚度不增身份。
真实源图保留作者标签，不假称模拟实时相机或原始二维像素数组。

Real RST300 whole-machine exterior dimensions and mass remain unknown; no numerical photo scaling substitutes these missing specifications. Geometry is an explicit task envelope around the documented 70mm scratch travel and 1mm depth range. 25kg is a numerical simulation budget only.

Qualitative shape follows official legacy photographs visibly labeled RST300, not the current shared-page RST100 photos. White front/blue sides, granite slab, black XY stages, microscope objective and adjacent indenter are represented.

Y travel +/-30mm and manual head lift0..40mm are engineering operating ranges. The fixed objective offsetY=-27mm and14mm clearance at nominal contact are engineering assembly assumptions, not measured OEM optical dimensions.

No automatic turret or tool changer is modeled. tool.select is a software workflow mode; XY specimen positioning supplies the modeled optical alignment. Lens internals, rear connector placement and force/depth sensor housing are engineering representations.

Installed specimen is120x80x6mm and installed stylus is a120deg spheroconical diamond with200um apex radius. Alternate specimens/tips and actual wear grooves do not dynamically replace or deform the displayed mesh.

Penetration0..1mm intentionally moves the diamond into the rigid displayed specimen as a process-depth visual proxy. Geometric interference checks exempt only this intended contact zone; no physical plasticity/fracture or calibrated contact force is claimed.
Clamp3mm release and coarse head access are manual motion proxies; human gripping, screw thread advance, handwheel transmission, optical ray tracing and metrological calibration are not implemented.
No numeric screen is present on the instrument and none is invented. External PC and its manufacturer GUI are outside this asset.
装样/移除API改变有限物料库存；可见试片和压头是已装配置代理，运行时未动态隐藏或替换mesh。
All depth/removal/thermal/force-control parameters are explicit engineering inputs; original Pd/Rd are not silently promoted to model truth.
High-range nominal0.2mN/.5nm resolutions and ideal-laboratory1mN/2.5nm RMS floors are specifications only; no achieved metrology or stochastic noise claim.
Default empirical record is bare borofloat glass from another scratch experiment, not native RST300 coating force/depth calibration.
Image references do not generate a new scratch image. Manufacturer panorama inspection limit30mm and scratch travel70mm are different; automatic panorama acquisition not implemented.
No manufacturer heater is invented. Heat comes only from declared portion of tangential work; passive cooling, no heating-control capability.
Normal plastic deformation/topographic work, real fracture/delamination, pile-up shape, AE waveform and actual indentation contact dynamics are not solved.
Observed postscan residual profile uses ideal nondestructive probe and explicit constant track width; not full Hertz/spheroconical cross-section inversion.
ASTM C1624 scope or CRM critical loads do not calibrate synthetic wear coefficients or confer certification.

coverage.note_zh: CHEM-129 Anton Paar RST300：真整机外廓/质量未知null，几何仅工程任务包络与25kg数值预算。真实库52记录/14材料体系，16跨仪器可运行原重复/6裸材；3原机标量记录但0原机数值曲线。30原重复52,900节点与6作者mean10,580节点、6无轴μ分别登记；29Lc与1剥离观察按原criterion保存。50材料未满足。五组预扫/划痕/后扫共15pass、有限试片/压头/碎屑与功热守恒只在真实报告通过后计入；涂层、回复/移除/热/传感与跨工况迁移均显式工程。summary_ready要求8项Matterix驱动、单测全API实际返回schema、几何/Blender/连续装配、来源逐点/哈希、独立物理/原表重分析、五流程与科学图全部实际通过；缺报仍not_run。原机校准/完整断裂场/AE全景/机器人硬件/外层异步身份与真实尺寸质量不在验证范围，交付partial。
